title: Cable Crunch
summary: A kneeling crunch against a cable, for the abs.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.4 for obliques (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Kneel facing a high pulley, holding a rope beside your head.
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis, rounding your spine.

form_cues.cue: Crunch your ribs toward your pelvis
Move your spine, not your hips. Your butt shouldn't sit back.

mistakes.text: Sitting back on the heels to pull with the hips.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Less constant tension.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
